data.how_to_apply: Students and Programming Languages researchers from around the world are welcome to apply. Priority is given to junior members, such as full- or part-time computer science students. Volunteers receive a complimentary conference registration, free lunches and refreshments, a volunteer shirt, and free admission to social events, though they must arrange their own travel and accommodation. To apply, visit the provided link.
